subject: Superbrain P0 authoritative verification and cold-start repair

project_context.current_objective: Obtain an authoritative Superbrain Gate GREEN on the repaired main state while preserving the protected GREEN boundary and proving clean cold-start restoration.

naya.title: Superbrain P0 Verification — Naya Note
naya.summary: The P0 verification pass repaired the canonical Smart Note corpus and then identified a second, independent acceptance defect: cold-start cleanliness was checked after earlier gate steps intentionally generated derived artifacts. The gate was corrected to test clean restoration before those artifacts exist. The current head remains PENDING until a fresh authoritative gate proves the correction.
lessons: Strict acceptance tests should run before the side effects they are intended to measure.
A failing acceptance test is valuable evidence; preserve it, identify the root cause, and repair the boundary rather than weakening the test.
Repository state, generated artifacts, and authoritative CI evidence must remain distinguishable.
next_best_actions: Obtain a fresh authoritative brain-gate on current main.
Inspect every substantive step and record exact evidence.
If GREEN, promote only evidence-supported capabilities and begin the highest-value remaining P1.

shawn.title: Superbrain P0 Verification — Shawn/Smart Note
shawn.summary: We found and fixed two different kinds of truth problems without weakening the brain: first stale memory relationships and INDEX drift, then a gate-order problem where the clean cold-start test ran after the gate itself created evidence files. The next run should now test the clean repository boundary first, then build the evidence artifacts.
lessons: Proof is only proof when the test observes the condition it claims to test.
The smartest repair preserves the validator and fixes the source or execution order.
Every failure should leave the next Naya with more useful experience than the previous Naya had.
next_best_actions: Run the authoritative Superbrain Gate on the current repaired main head.
Show the real brain-gate logs and receipts.
Promote the repaired foundation only after the actual gate is GREEN.
